metadata.proofAlgorithm: OpenZeppelin-style standard Merkle tree: double keccak256(abi.encode(uint8 route,address wallet)); sorted pair hashes
limitations: This preserves the mint eligibility list, not an official or current Portal tier attestation.
The source manifest does not specify the time of its underlying Portal snapshot.
Only Gold I, Gold II, Gold III and the four higher named tier groups are present. Higher groups do not disclose sublevels.
Friends-and-family entries do not establish any Portal tier.
No XP amounts, signer addresses/private keys, badge data, or bridge activity are included.
Wallets have not been individually checked against the AGW registry or for their owner state.
Merkle verification confirms consistency with the website manifest, not that the original tier assignment is accurate.
